title: Replace the description of an OpenProject work package
description: On a work package page: clicks the description (a button until clicked), waits for the rich-text editor, replaces its content, and saves. Saving is the last step and runs only when the person asked for exactly this change; without it the edited text stays in the open editor for the person to review. Matched on any domain by OpenProject's page metadata.

params.name: text
params.description: The new description. HTML is allowed (headings, lists, bold, links) and lands formatted. It REPLACES the old one.

steps.note: The description is a button until clicked.
